purpose: Qualify one exact v12 tree after binding authoritative GitHub Actions recency to immutable run creation identity (created_at, run_number, run id and run attempt), explicitly excluding completion metadata such as updated_at so an older late-finishing success cannot outrank a newer failed, cancelled or active run; preserving the repeatedly revalidated frozen hosted snapshot, exact runner/job/required-step attestation, immutable no-follow payload freeze, closed secret-safe namespace, canonical thirteen-record waiver-free manifest, exact migration and receipt recovery controls, governance observations, and X1-X8 external-gate separation.
